knowledge:
- key_parameters: tube.set=list of flowFrame objects representing the tubes ;; control.tubes=integer vector specifying the indices of negative control tubes ;; bin.pars=integer vector of column indices for shared markers used to bin cells ;; measure.pars=list of integer vectors specifying the column indices of tube-specific markers to measure ;; expr.method=character string specifying the expression calculation method, either 'medianFIDist' or 'propPos' ;; scale.expr=logical indicating whether to scale the resulting expression values to the interval [0, 1]
- alternatives: None mentioned; uses flowFP internally for fingerprinting and binning.
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing multitube flow cytometry panels where each tube contains a subset of specific markers alongside a shared set of reference/binning markers, allowing integration into a single unified matrix.
- pitfalls: Technical variation across tubes can distort binning; quantile normalization (quantileNormalise) should be performed and checked using checkQNorm to identify problematic tubes (e.g., outliers like tube 4 in the vignette).

workflows.name: multitube_flow_integration
workflows.intent: Integrate multitube flow cytometry data with shared markers into a single expression matrix using quantile normalization and binning.
input: fs1 (flowSet object containing flowFrames for each tube)
workflows.stages: 1. Create a FlowSample object defining binning and measurement parameters ;; 2. Perform quantile normalization on the binning markers across tubes ;; 3. Verify normalization quality using standard deviation of bin densities ;; 4. Run flowBin to combine tubes into an expression matrix using 'medianFIDist' or 'propPos' methods ;; 5. Visualize the integrated expression matrix using a heatmap
workflows.code:
library(flowBin)
library(flowFP)
data(fs1)
aml.sample <- new('FlowSample',
				  			name='Example flowSample', 
                            tube.set=as.list(fs1@frames), 
                            control.tubes=c(1), 
                            bin.pars=c(1,2,5), 
                            measure.pars=list(c(3,4,6,7)))
normed.sample <- quantileNormalise(aml.sample)
qnorm.check <- checkQNorm(aml.sample, normed.sample, do.plot=F)
tube.combined <- flowBin(tube.list=aml.sample@tube.set, 
bin.pars=aml.sample@bin.pars, 
control.tubes=aml.sample@control.tubes, 
expr.method='medianFIDist', 
scale.expr=T)
heatmap(tube.combined, scale='none')
tube.propPos <- flowBin(tube.list=aml.sample@tube.set, 
bin.pars=aml.sample@bin.pars, 
control.tubes=aml.sample@control.tubes, 
expr.method='propPos', 
scale.expr=T)
heatmap(tube.propPos, scale='none')
